name: Block sudo Commands
description: Blocks any Bash command that uses sudo and tells Claude to ask the user, protecting shared lab machines.
author: Promptzyra
install:
1. Save the script under .claude/hooks/ and make it executable (chmod +x).
2. Copy the "hooks" block from settings-hooks.json into .claude/settings.json.
3. Start a new Claude Code session.
Hooks run shell commands with your permissions, so read every script before enabling it.

files.content:
#!/bin/bash
# Exit code 2 blocks the tool call and sends stderr to Claude.
INPUT=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty')
if echo "$INPUT" | grep -Eq '(^|[;&| ])sudo '; then
  echo "sudo is blocked here. Ask the user to run it themselves." >&2
  exit 2
fi
exit 0

name: Block curl Piped to Shell
description: Stops commands that download a script and pipe it straight into sh or bash, a risky habit worth teaching against.
author: Promptzyra
install:

Hooks run shell commands with your permissions, so read every script before enabling it.

files.content:
#!/bin/bash
# Exit code 2 blocks the tool call and sends stderr to Claude.
INPUT=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty')
if echo "$INPUT" | grep -Eq '(curl|wget)[^|]*\|[[:space:]]*(sudo )?(ba)?sh'; then
  echo "Piping a download into a shell is blocked. Download, read, then run it." >&2
  exit 2
fi
exit 0

Run the setup script from that URL

fi
exit 0

3. Start a new Claude Code session.
4. Requires jq.
Hooks run shell commands with your permissions, so read every script before enabling it.
